notes:
• New backup player: video your TV can't decode (10-bit H.264 anime, VC-1, 10-bit AV1) now plays instead of being skipped
• AV1 up to 1080p plays on devices without hardware AV1 (like the SHIELD); FLAC audio fixed on TVs where it stopped mid-play
• Playback recovers: dropped connections reconnect, failed audio switches decoder, and a bad source puts you back where you were
• Player: Sources button to switch source mid-play; Skip Intro/Recap counts down and fades
• After a season finale Play moves on to the next season; when nothing new has aired it offers Rewatch S1 E1 and says when the next episode airs
• Stopping at the credits counts as watched on Trakt/Simkl
• Phones and tablets: just rows on Home, pauses for calls/headphones, and press back again to exit
• New settings in Sources & Playback: Player engine, Audio decoders, Buffer size
